Patch 0.29.4 (Boosted Spirit Guardians now stays authoritative across compressed sync)

  • Boosted guardians now stay on the authoritative path: Boosted Spirit Guardians now syncs through both the server delta snapshot tracker and the client-side shared support helper instead of dropping that boosted state on compressed updates.
  • Guardian boost metadata now matches the rest of the support sync line: This keeps guardian boost metadata aligned with the rest of the authoritative support-state replication path, so boosted guardians stay visible and mechanically correct after the initial cast snapshot.
  • Buff tracking stays truthful: The active buff tracker can now keep showing boosted guardians from authoritative state instead of silently falling back to the normal guardian variant.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for boosted guardian delta tracking, boosted guardian client sync, and 0.29.4 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.3 (Spirit Guardians now reliably triggers compressed server state updates)

  • Guardian delta sync now participates in server change tracking: Spirit Guardians state now participates in the server delta snapshot change tracker, so guardian-only activation and expiry cannot get skipped by compressed state broadcasts.
  • The server support-state set is more internally consistent: This keeps the server delta path aligned with the newer support-effect replication set instead of leaving Spirit Guardians outside the consolidated comparison block.
  • Client readability now gets a steadier authoritative trigger: Nearby guardian state readability and the shared client-side support sync path now have a more reliable authoritative trigger to react to.
  • Regression coverage: Added server regression coverage for Spirit Guardians delta snapshot tracking and 0.29.3 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.2 (Spirit Guardians sync now uses the shared support effect helper)

  • Spirit Guardians now rides the shared sync path: Spirit Guardians now also syncs through the shared support-effect helper instead of keeping a separate one-off apply and teardown path.
  • Guardian teardown is now narrowly scoped: Server-driven guardian expiry now clears only guardian state instead of routing through broader cleric ability cancellation that could drop unrelated support effects.
  • The 0.29 consolidation line closes another gap: This closes the last major support-effect holdout from the 0.29 sync consolidation line while keeping nearby guardians readability unchanged.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for guardian-only synced teardown and 0.29.2 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.1 (Local authoritative buff sync now reuses the shared effect helper)

  • Local buff sync now rides the same path: The new shared effect sync path now also applies to the local authoritative player state, so server-driven buff expiry and consumption stop depending on one-off manual sync logic.
  • Remote and local rules now match: Time Warp, Spell Focus, Arcane Shield, and the newer support flags now clear or apply through the same helper whether the affected actor is local or remote.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues: This extends the 0.29 cleanup from remote readability into local correctness for server-authoritative buff and control state updates.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for local authoritative effect sync reuse and 0.29.1 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.0 (Remote buff replication now runs through one shared effect sync registry)

  • Remote effect sync is now centralized: Remote support and control buffs now sync through one shared effect registry instead of a growing chain of hand-written per-flag blocks inside remote entity state handling.
  • The current replicated buff set now shares one path: Guardian Embrace, Blessing of Resolve, Divine Intervention, Arcane Shield, Time Warp, and Spell Focus now all reuse the same remote effect sync path while preserving their existing player-facing callouts.
  • This starts the next cleanup line: This starts the next multiplayer cleanup line by consolidating server-authoritative buff replication rules before more support and control flags are added.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for the shared remote effect sync registry and 0.29.0 version presentation.

Patch 0.28.8 (Spell Focus now reads as a real remote charge-up buff)

  • Another wizard prep state now truly replicates: Spell Focus now replicates through the hot-path multiplayer state snapshot so nearby clients can track that charged-cast window in real time.
  • Remote cast prep reads clearly: Nearby remote wizards now surface FOCUS UP and FOCUS DOWN readability, and the replicated state now drives the existing spell-focus multiplier path instead of leaving remote prep windows implicit.
  • Wizard setup rules stay consistent: Activation still de-dupes against the explicit Spell Focus cast label, keeping the wizard utility readability rules consistent across buff and setup states.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for Spell Focus replication readability and 0.28.8 version presentation.

Patch 0.28.7 (Time Warp now reads as a real remote haste window)

  • Another wizard utility state now truly replicates: Time Warp now replicates through the hot-path multiplayer state snapshot so nearby clients can track that haste window in real time.
  • Remote haste reads clearly: Nearby remote wizards now surface WARP UP and WARP DOWN readability, and the replicated state now drives the existing haste buff path instead of leaving remote Time Warp implicit.
  • Wizard support rules stay consistent: Activation still de-dupes against the explicit Time Warp cast label, keeping the support-state presentation rules consistent across the wizard utility kit.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for Time Warp replication readability and 0.28.7 version presentation.

Patch 0.28.6 (Arcane Shield now reads as a real remote protective shield state)

  • Shield truth now replicates properly: Arcane Shield now replicates through the hot-path multiplayer state snapshot with both its active flag and remaining shield value so nearby clients can track the protection state truthfully.
  • Remote wizard protection reads clearly: Nearby remote wizards now surface SHIELD UP and SHIELD DOWN readability, and the replicated shield value now feeds the existing shield buff tracker path instead of leaving remote shield state implicit.
  • Support rules still stay consistent: Activation still de-dupes against the explicit Arcane Shield cast label, keeping the growing support-state line consistent even for HP-backed protective buffs.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for Arcane Shield replication readability, buff tracking, and 0.28.6 version presentation.

Patch 0.28.5 (Remote support readability now runs through one shared registry)

  • Support metadata is now centralized: Remote support-state readability now pulls its labels, colors, and cast de-dupe mapping from one shared registry instead of a growing chain of per-buff conditionals.
  • The current support set now rides one path: Spirit Guardians, Guardian Embrace, Blessing of Resolve, and Divine Intervention now all ride the same support metadata path, making the 0.28 support pass easier to extend without re-teaching timing rules each time.
  • Behavior stays stable while the foundation improves: This keeps behavior unchanged for existing support auras while setting up the next replicated buff slices on a cleaner shared foundation.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for the shared remote support registry and 0.28.5 version presentation.

Patch 0.28.4 (Divine Intervention now reads as a real remote rescue buff)

  • Another timed support flag now truly replicates: Divine Intervention now replicates through the hot-path multiplayer state snapshot so nearby clients can track that rescue buff in real time.
  • Remote cleric protection reads richer: Nearby remote clerics now surface INTERVENTION UP and INTERVENTION DOWN readability, extending the support-state pass to another real timed protection effect.
  • Support de-dupe rules still hold: Activation still de-dupes against the explicit Divine Intervention cast label, so the added support-state visibility does not reintroduce duplicate callouts.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for Divine Intervention replication readability and 0.28.4 version presentation.
